thread:
Nina (CS): Morning — Cornerstone onboarding hitting 5xx on embeddings to their private pool since ~07:05 PT. Customer flagging stalled jobs. Raising here for quick mitigation + customer note.
Raj (SRE): Looks like the private node config lost a GPU driver after a restart, causing worker crashes and 502/503. Restarting worker with pinned driver now. ETA ~15m.
Ethan (AE): They're a pilot customer, 25 seats. Renewal conversation later this year. Need a short, clear comms offer we can send ASAP.
Support Bot: INC-4980 created. Severity P2.
Raj (SRE): Hotfix applied at 07:22 PT; worker stable but backlog persists. I can enable a temporary routing to hosted embeddings for project CS-44 if CS approves. That should clear the queue in ~10m.
Nina (CS): Draft to customer: "Hi Cornerstone — we saw transient worker failures in your private pool and have enabled a temporary routing to our hosted embeddings so your batch can finish. No data will be stored outside your project. We'll follow up with an RCA and offer a credit for the window. Please reply if you'd rather pause jobs instead."
Mika (Customer): Thanks — please proceed with fallback. We prefer it to pausing. Keep us posted on RCA and credit.
Raj (SRE): Fallback enabled at 07:35 PT for CS-44. Success rate improved to 99% within 4 minutes. Monitoring for any retry storms.
Nina (CS): CS action items: (1) apply goodwill credit after impact window confirmed, (2) schedule 30-min tech sync after RCA, (3) update renewal risk dashboard. Lina, can you tag CS-44?
Lina (RevOps): Done 4 tagged in renewal-risk tracker.
Nina (CS): Thanks team — I'll send the full post-incident note to Cornerstone once Raj posts the RCA draft.
notes: Worker driver restart + hosted fallback; credit offer; renewal risk tag
